notes.title: Language support update
notes.content: The game interface adds support for Turkish and Polish.

notes.title: Optimized loading and user experience.
notes.content: Some users report that the game is very unfriendly. We reviewed the entire game process and optimized the process, hoping to have better results.

notes.title: Japanese and Korean are now online
notes.content: There are many things and work is very busy, but we have added support for Japanese and Korean users
